lessons.trigger_condition: V419 could discover and evidence-gate non-core TCG categories, and purchase_intelligence could resolve promoted games, but four general tablet market selectors still remained static/core-oriented and /api/purchase-live-search rejected every non-core game before the registry-aware resolver could run. This left PROMOTED games only partially equivalent to Pokémon, ONE PIECE and NARUTO on tablet market/purchase surfaces.
lessons.prevention_rule: Populate general tablet market selectors from tcg_game_registry CORE/PROMOTED rows with market capability, use canonical values for general market surfaces, keep promo/purchase declared surface values, and let purchase_intelligence perform the authoritative CORE/PROMOTED game gate. HTTP routing may validate length/region/origin/rate limits only; WATCH and unregistered games remain fail-closed in the resolver. Non-core grading remains disabled until separate calibration.

lessons.safety_boundary: This lesson expands only verified registry-driven market and purchase routing for already CORE/PROMOTED categories. It does not promote WATCH games, guarantee profit, infer price direction, fabricate inventory, auto-enable non-core grading, alter the 17→12→18 neural architecture, weaken CI, or claim physical Lenovo deployment.
